{"response":{"usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":584,"thoughtsTokenCount":7948,"totalTokenCount":14436,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5904,"modality":"TEXT"}],"promptTokenCount":5904},"candidates":[{"citationMetadata":{"citationSources":[{"license":"","endIndex":315,"startIndex":7,"uri":"https://github.com/ChunxiaoIanLi/RL_reset"}]},"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Immediate 'good-phase' guard.\n  // Check the fast exponential moving average of LBD.\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  if (fast \u003c 2.0)\n    return false;\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate the depth_ratio.\n  // Using solver-\u003elevel and solver-\u003eaverages[solver-\u003estable].level (via AVERAGE macro).\n  // Note: AVERAGE(level) is only available if QUIET is not defined.\n  double penalty = 1.0;\n\n#ifndef QUIET\n  const double avg_level = AVERAGE (level);\n  if (avg_level \u003e 0.0) {\n    const double depth_ratio = (double) solver-\u003elevel / avg_level;\n    // Step 3: Compute a dynamic penalty factor.\n    // penalty = max(1.0, depth_ratio).\n    if (depth_ratio \u003e 1.0)\n      penalty = depth_ratio;\n  }\n#endif\n\n  // Step 4: Modify the restart evaluation score.\n  // weighted_fast_lbd = fast_lbd_ema * penalty.\n  const double weighted_fast_lbd = fast * penalty;\n\n  // Step 5: Calculate assignment_inertia and threshold.\n  double assignment_inertia = 0.0;\n  if (solver-\u003evars) {\n    assignment_inertia = (double) (solver-\u003evars - solver-\u003eunassigned) / (double) solver-\u003evars;\n  }\n\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n  // Corresponds to solver-\u003ebounds.restart.factor in algorithm description\n  const double margin = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n  \n  const double threshold = margin * slow * (1.0 + assignment_inertia);\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart check: fast=%g penalty=%g weighted=%g threshold=%g (inertia=%g)\",\n                            fast, penalty, weighted_fast_lbd, threshold, assignment_inertia);\n\n  return (weighted_fast_lbd \u003e threshold);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]},"index":0}],"responseId":"dtWKae_JD_evqtsPoYnE8QQ","modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
